name: designtwin
description: Free-plan Figma→code workflow: a Plugin API extractor + skills that audit a design for implementation gaps (states, tokens, accessibility, platform translation) and build any-stack (React/Tailwind, CSS Modules, React Native, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Flutter) screens from a Figma export, with a token/component drift check, and re-sync built code when the design changes without rebuilding it.
